initial_frame.question: Can a model-selected read-only file event be recorded as a successful answer when the continuation is empty or emits another tool envelope?
initial_frame.baseline: Original source completed such episodes without a final answer
initial_frame.expected: Fail-closed completion status with a typed reason and no additional file-tool side effects
initial_frame.counterexamples: Valid final plain text and unrelated JSON answer must still complete
initial_frame.scope: Synthetic model transport and actual Studio engine/storage code under GitLab CI; no real LLM or Chromium invocation

red_green_verification.red_result: failed: three precise regression assertions on original false-success implementation
red_green_verification.statuses: six successful on exact pinned source; no deployment

defect_family.trigger: A model emits a completed read-only JSON tool call followed by an empty string or another tool-shaped JSON response
defect_family.root_cause: Studio treated a no-tool-calls local-model reply as successful without checking whether it was the promised final answer
defect_family.fix: Reject empty or raw/fenced JSON tool-shaped replies only after adapted read-only completion; persist model_continuation_rejected event and retain original artifact receipt
remaining_risks: Native-model quality remains unmeasured by this patch
Tool JSON detection is a syntactic guard, not a content verification model
